precon.label: Contract signed (deposit); HOA ACC request + drawings submitted the same week
Field verification: deck heights, ledger bands, old column centres, slab edges, chimney nook; dig beside one old column per level to expose its footing (footings.md 7, 13); private-line locate
Tiffany HOA ACC review — submit >= 3 weeks before work; ACC allows up to 3 weeks
Stamped engineering (6x10 DF beams outside IRC tables; 8x8 DF columns on 20" caissons): GSX planning 2-3 weeks
Centennial deck permit: intake + plan-review fee (~2 bd), review 5 bd after fee paid, issue (~1 bd), +2 bd buffer; a comment round adds up to 5 bd
Order 8x8 DF #1 rough + 6x10 DF (special order via D&D): 10-15 bd planning; release earlier on the engineer's preliminary sizes if possible
Order Simpson ABU88RZ bases + CCQ/ECCQ caps (rough W2 = 8" is a Simpson special order) via D&D; Sonotubes, rebar, anchors, concrete from stock
Order Vintage English Walnut deck boards/fascia/risers + Cortex EW plugs (stock at D&D Denver unconfirmed; ProDeck MN quotes <2 wk)
Order IRX black panels/posts (stock) + drink-rail panel covers (special order) + clip kits
Option 1: order TimberTech lights/transformer (not on any D&D quote; retail stock is shallow)
Colorado 811 locates (2-3 business days; marks good ~30 days)

roof_precon.label: Planning: written LDC 12-14-805 interpretation that the louvered roof is a 'pergola' (3 ft) not an attached roof (20 ft rear setback) — STOP until answered; variance path = P&Z hearing 6-10 wk
Suncoast Denver (Cale Pilling) site visit + measure (soffit/roof line; deck side from GSX drawings)
Dealer sends post reactions (down/uplift, base shear) to the GSX engineer (deck limits ~2,900 lb down / 1,400 lb up per post)
Dealer drawings + Colorado-PE stamped engineering (30 psf non-reducible + sliding snow, 115 mph, soffit/roof-line attachment)
Separate Centennial patio-cover permit (zoning approval required; 5 bd review after fee) after the Planning answer
Factory: released on the Planning answer + deposit; 6-8 wk (Marygrove), 6-10 wk (Paragon), Suncoast unpublished -> 7 wk planning
